introduction.title: Advanced Flow Rules and Actions
introduction.text: Flow rules are the backbone of PEGA's process automation capabilities. At the intermediate level, we explore sophisticated flow patterns, advanced actions, and complex business logic implementation that enables robust, scalable, and maintainable business processes.

sections.content: Robust error handling is crucial for production-ready flows.

Use default values when external data is unavailable
Implement fallback mechanisms for failed integrations

Implement compensating actions for each major operation
Use saga patterns for long-running transactions
error_handling_strategies.example: Cancel reservation if payment processing fails

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Advanced flow patterns enable sophisticated business process automation
Complex flow actions provide powerful capabilities for user interaction and system integration
Robust error handling and exception management are essential for production systems
Performance optimization techniques ensure scalable and responsive applications
Comprehensive testing strategies validate flow behavior under various conditions
Advanced concepts like dynamic generation and orchestration enable enterprise-scale solutions
Monitoring and analytics provide insights for continuous process improvement
